title: 风借来的一颗星
style: 原创曲线插画、深靛与青绿层景、珊瑚斗篷、金色细线、宋体真实轮廓字幕变换

atlas.sample: R; manual bilinear; positive inside; PNG top-left tiles; glyph UV Y flipped

font.characters: !"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~。一久也了于些交人以会借到前勇叶向吹回图地夜天她子它家小很忘成把折敢散整方星是曾替有来次每没灯点片的直种空纸给船被起路迷那都长颗风驶，

vector_morph.method: paired closed contours; equal-arc samples; nonzero winding
vector_morph.extraction: marching squares at SDF byte threshold 127.5; bilinear crossings; cell-mean saddle choice
vector_morph.coordinates: local glyph coordinates in [-0.5,0.5], Y up; 16-bit unsigned xy
vector_morph.packing: two RGBA pixels per vertex (source/target); all-255 contour break
vector_morph.component_matching: outer components first; holes only within matched parent; winding and cyclic phase aligned
vector_morph.birth_death: zero-area contours grow from or contract to nearest boundary anchors; no opacity ramp
vector_morph.endpoints: original SDF; 2.5% endpoint interval reconciles polygon sampling and SDF AA
vector_morph.limitations: bounded polygon approximation, not native Manim curve topology or pixel-equivalent Transform

illustration.provenance: original hand-authored cubic Bezier paths; no external image assets
illustration.figure: six-head curved profile; bent hands; flowing hair, cloak and skirt
illustration.transition: corresponding Bezier controls and resampled closed contours; no full-scene crossfade

chapters.title: 失星的村落
chapters.action: 弧顶村屋依坡地分层，风线绕过月牙与屋檐；最后一颗星落下。

chapters.title: 掌心的种子
chapters.action: 六头身侧脸少女用弯曲的双臂接住种子，斗篷、发丝与风线连续流动。

chapters.title: 没有地图的天空
chapters.action: 同一组风曲线重构为弧形帆船和云卷，青绿云海分层展开。

chapters.title: 风也会迷路
chapters.action: 船与波浪的对应控制点抬升成弯曲枝干，少女护住种子的光。

chapters.title: 星光生根
chapters.action: 森林曲线收束为不对称光树，种子落地拉长成树干，侧枝与光叶生长。

chapters.title: 回家的方向
chapters.action: 叶、燕、星使用同一组64点闭合轮廓连续变换；树枝重构为鸟翼。

chapters.title: 风借来的一颗星
chapters.action: 鸟翼继续重构成星图，前句宋体字幕重构为片名，结语从片名字形派生展开。

subtitles.text: 很久以前，星星忘了回家的路。
subtitles.transition: closed-contour point correspondence; no sentence alpha fade

subtitles.text: 直到风，把一颗种子交给了她。
subtitles.transition: closed-contour point correspondence; no sentence alpha fade

subtitles.text: 她折一叶纸船，驶向没有地图的天空。
subtitles.transition: closed-contour point correspondence; no sentence alpha fade

subtitles.text: 风也会迷路。勇敢的人，会替它点灯。
subtitles.transition: closed-contour point correspondence; no sentence alpha fade

subtitles.text: 于是，一颗小小的星，长成了一整片夜空。
subtitles.transition: closed-contour point correspondence; no sentence alpha fade

subtitles.text: 那些曾被吹散的，都有了回家的方向。
subtitles.transition: closed-contour point correspondence; no sentence alpha fade
closed-contour point correspondence; no sentence alpha fade

subtitles.text: 每一次风起，都是星星回家的路
